full_text_en:
Wuxi Beitang District People's Procuratorate v. Shu Zhaolong — embezzlement case

【Ruling Summary】

Pursuant to Article 382, Paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law, where a defendant, during the restructuring of a state-owned institution, takes advantage of his position to conceal state-owned assets and transfers them to a company in which he holds an investment stake after the restructuring, he constitutes the crime of embezzlement. However, the amount of embezzlement shall be determined in proportion to the defendant's investment stake in the restructured company.

Prosecutorial Authority: Wuxi Beitang District People's Procuratorate, Jiangsu Province.

Defendant: Shu Zhaolong, male, 58 years old, residing at Huaigu New Village, Wuxi City, Jiangsu Province; formerly Director of Wuxi Beitang District Architectural Design and Research Institute; arrested on October 29, 2004.

The Wuxi Beitang District People's Procuratorate, Jiangsu Province, instituted a public prosecution against the defendant Shu Zhaolong for the crime of embezzlement, and filed the case with the Wuxi Beitang District People's Court, Jiangsu Province.

The indictment alleged: The defendant Shu Zhaolong, taking advantage of his position as Director of the former Wuxi Beitang District Architectural Design and Research Institute (hereinafter referred to as the "Former Institute"), failed to truthfully declare, in accordance with the regulations, accounts receivable totaling RMB 1,020,795 under the architectural design project contracts undertaken by the Former Institute prior to the base date of its restructuring as a state-owned institution, and thereby embezzled over RMB 410,000 of public funds. Shu Zhaolong's conduct has violated Article 382 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China (hereinafter the "Criminal Law") and constitutes the crime of embezzlement. A conviction and sentence according to law were requested.

The prosecutor adduced the following evidence:

1. The business license of the Former Institute, cadre resume form, appointment notice of the People's Government of Beitang District, Wuxi City, company change approval notice, and company change verification form, to prove that the Former Institute was a state-owned institution; that Shu Zhaolong was a state cadre and was appointed Director of the Former Institute on June 8, 1995; that on September 5, 2003, upon approval by the administrative department for industry and commerce, the Former Institute was restructured into Wuxi Jiade Architectural Design Co., Ltd. (hereinafter "Jiade Company", with a limited liability company economic nature) with registered capital of RMB 650,000; that Shu Zhaolong's individual investment accounted for 25% of the total capital of Jiade Company, the investment of the state-owned institution Wuxi Municipal Engineering Design and Research Institute (hereinafter "Municipal Design Institute") accounted for 10%, and the investments of 16 other natural persons accounted for 65%.

2. Testimony of witness Liu Xiaoya, the main contents being: Upon approval by the relevant department of the People's Government of Beitang District, Wuxi City, the Former Institute commenced restructuring in the second half of 2002, designated Wuxi Baoguang Accounting Firm (hereinafter "Baoguang Accounting Firm") to conduct the asset appraisal, and set November 30, 2002, as the appraisal base date.

3. Testimony of witness Wei Xinhua, the main contents being: In accordance with the arrangements of Baoguang Accounting Firm, in December 2002, he began to appraise the assets of the Former Institute.

4. Statement of current liabilities and assets, asset appraisal report, appraisal report No. Xi Bao Ping Bao Zi (2002) No. 173, "Reply Approving the Restructuring of Wuxi Beitang District Architectural Design and Research Institute into a Limited Liability Company", asset transfer agreement, net asset handover list, and appraisal report No. Xi Bao Ping Bao Zi (2004) No. 12, to prove that as of the restructuring base date of November 30, 2002, the net asset value declared by the Former Institute and appraised by Baoguang Accounting Firm was RMB 693,000; that upon approval of the Reform Work Leading Group Office of Beitang District, Wuxi City, Shu Zhaolong and others together with the Municipal Design Institute purchased the Former Institute for RMB 650,000, established Jiade Company, and the Former Institute was restructured into a limited liability company; that upon reappraisal, the net asset value that the Former Institute failed to truthfully declare prior to the restructuring base date was RMB 413,287.78.

5. Testimony of witnesses Zhang Jiaqing and Yang Zhicheng, the main contents being: The Former Institute had undertaken the engineering design projects of Huai'an Vanke Beijing Garden Community and Shuofang Town Xingyueyuan Zone B, and was commissioned by Wuxi Civil Building Design Institute (hereinafter "Civil Building Design Institute") to design the Longhaiyuan Phase I Project, Yandu Hongdu Garden, Oriental Auto City Shanghai Volkswagen Franchised Store, and New Countryside Housing East of Jinhaili; all design contracts of the Former Institute were signed and kept by Shu Zhaolong.

6. Testimony of witnesses Wang Xiaoqing and Zhou Feifei, the main contents being: The accounts receivable for design projects recorded in the financial accounts of the Former Institute only reflected the amounts for which invoices had been issued but payments had not yet been collected, as instructed by Shu Zhaolong; as for the design fees for completed design contracts of the Former Institute for which no invoices had been issued and no payments had been collected, the financial accounts could not reflect them, and only Shu Zhaolong knew about them, because essentially all design fees were personally pursued by Shu Zhaolong.

7. Testimony of witnesses Yu Zonghong, Xia Chun, Liu Mo, Shi Hanjun, Zhou Yayuan, Wang Xudong, Fu Yuzheng, Zhou Limei, and Tang Xiaoyong, the main contents being: They did not know about the restructuring of their unit, the Former Institute, until approximately July 2003.

8. Engineering survey and design agreement, to prove that on July 18, 2002, Shu Zhaolong, in the name of the Municipal Design Institute and Wuxi Science and Technology Consulting Service Center, entered into an agreement with the People's Government of Shuofang Town, New District, Wuxi City, to undertake the survey and design work for the Shuofang Town Xingyueyuan Zone B project.

9. Testimony of witnesses Zhang Zaiqun and Lu Yigang, the main contents being: They had commissioned the unit represented by Shu Zhaolong to undertake the survey and design work for the Shuofang Town Xingyueyuan Zone B project.

10. Construction engineering design contract, to prove that in June 2001, Wuxi Tongbao Real Estate Co., Ltd. commissioned the Former Institute to design the Huai'an Vanke Beijing Garden Community project.

11. Testimony of witness Xie Yubao, the main contents being: The architectural design work for the Huai'an Vanke Beijing Garden Community was commissioned to the Former Institute, and the design fees were paid to the Former Institute.

12. Construction engineering design contracts, to prove that the design work for the Longhaiyuan Phase I Project, Yandu Hongdu Garden, Oriental Auto City Shanghai Volkswagen Franchised Store, and New Countryside Housing East of Jinhaili were all undertaken by the Civil Building Design Institute through contracts entered into with Wuxi Jinfeng Real Estate Development Co., Ltd., Yandu County Affordable Housing Development Center, Wuxi Commercial Building Group Oriental Automotive Co., Ltd., and the Dongfeng Residents' Committee of Nanchang Town, Binhu District, Wuxi City.

13. Testimony of witness Xu Jianyi, the main contents being: The Longhaiyuan Phase I Project, Yandu Hongdu Garden, Oriental Auto City Shanghai Volkswagen Franchised Store, and New Countryside Housing East of Jinhaili, which were undertaken by the Civil Building Design Institute, were all commissioned to the Former Institute for design, and the design fees were also paid to the Former Institute; for the Yandu Hongdu Garden project, Shu Zhaolong arranged for Qian Yan to carry out the design.

14. Testimony of witness Qian Yan, the main contents being: Assigned by Shu Zhaolong, Director of the Former Institute, he went to the Civil Building Design Institute to undertake the design work for the Yandu Hongdu Garden project.

15. Payment and accounting vouchers, to prove the payment of design fees by the above-mentioned entities.

The defendant Shu Zhaolong argued: (1) After Qian Yan, the project design leader for the Yandu Hongdu Garden project, completed the design work, he had already taken a bonus of RMB 21,500 from the project's design fee of RMB 86,000. However, in the appraisal report No. Xi Bao Ping Bao Zi (2004) No. 12 issued by Baoguang Accounting Firm, the RMB 21,500 bonus was not deducted from the undeclared net assets; (2) The design fee received by the Former Institute from the Shuofang Town Xingyueyuan Zone B project included a survey fee payable to the East China Branch of China Nonferrous Metals Industry Changsha Survey and Design Institute (hereinafter "East China Survey Institute"), which should also be deducted from the undeclared net assets confirmed in the appraisal report; (3) The failure to declare certain accounts receivable under contracts during the restructuring was intended to benefit the restructured entity and all its employees, not to seek personal gain; (4) After being brought to justice, he voluntarily confessed the fact of concealing the accounts receivable for the projects commissioned by the Civil Building Design Institute to the Former Institute. In light of the above, he requested a lenient punishment.

Shu Zhaolong's defense counsel submitted: (1) The project cost settlement list between the Former Institute and the Municipal Design Institute provided by the defendant Shu Zhaolong confirmed that the design fee received by the Former Institute from the Shuofang Town Xingyueyuan Zone B project included the survey fee payable to the East China Survey Institute; therefore, this amount should be deducted from the undeclared net assets confirmed in the appraisal report; (2) During the restructuring, Shu Zhaolong's failure to declare certain accounts receivable under contracts was subjectively aimed at considering the livelihood of the employees after the restructuring, not for his own benefit; objectively, the restructured company was not Shu Zhaolong's wholly-owned company, and the design fees recovered could not be appropriated by Shu Zhaolong. Therefore, treating all design fees recovered after the Former Institute was restructured into a company as the amount embezzled by Shu Zhaolong had no legal basis, and Shu Zhaolong's conduct did not meet the elements of the crime of embezzlement; (3) Regarding the accounts receivable for the projects commissioned by the Civil Building Design Institute to the Former Institute, Shu Zhaolong voluntarily confessed this fact after being brought to justice. Even if Shu Zhaolong's conduct constituted a crime, it amounted to voluntary surrender, and a lighter punishment should be imposed.

The Wuxi Beitang District People's Court found through trial:

In the second half of 2002, upon approval of the Reform Work Leading Group Office of Beitang District, Wuxi City, the wholly people-owned Former Institute commenced restructuring. It commissioned Baoguang Accounting Firm to appraise all its assets and liabilities, and set November 30, 2002, as the asset appraisal base date. The defendant Shu Zhaolong, taking advantage of his position as Director of the Former Institute, failed to truthfully declare, in accordance with the regulations, accounts receivable totaling RMB 1,020,795 under the architectural design project contracts undertaken by the Former Institute prior to the restructuring base date. Consequently, Baoguang Accounting Firm's asset appraisal report submitted on June 11, 2003, did not appraise this part of the assets.

On September 5, 2003, as confirmed by the industrial and commercial change registration, the Former Institute was renamed Jiade Company. Shu Zhaolong's individual investment accounted for 25% of the total investment of Jiade Company, and he became the legal representative of Jiade Company. The investment of another state-owned institution, the Municipal Design Institute, accounted for 10% of the total investment of Jiade Company.

After the case was discovered, Baoguang Accounting Firm reappraised the RMB 1,020,795 in accounts receivable under the architectural design project contracts that the Former Institute had failed to truthfully declare. After deducting the costs and expenses that the Former Institute should have paid to perform the contracts prior to the restructuring base date, and further deducting the fees that should be collected by Jiade Company for performing the contracts on behalf of the Former Institute after the restructuring base date, Baoguang Accounting Firm confirmed that the concealed net asset value of the Former Institute was RMB 413,287.78. This amount was collected by Jiade Company, the successor of the Former Institute.

After the Former Institute assigned Qian Yan as the project leader to perform the construction engineering design contract for Yandu Hongdu Garden, the engineering design fee of RMB 86,000 was received after the restructuring base date. In February 2003, Qian Yan received a bonus of RMB 21,500, calculated at 25%, for completing this project. The bonus received by Qian Yan after the restructuring base date was not deducted from the concealed net asset value confirmed by Baoguang Accounting Firm. The survey fee for the Shuofang Town Xingyueyuan Zone B project had already been paid directly by the Municipal Design Institute from the project's design fee to the East China Survey Institute, which had completed the survey work. The concealed net asset value confirmed by Baoguang Accounting Firm only included the design fee after deducting the survey fee; therefore, the survey fee should not be further deducted from the concealed net asset value. After deducting the bonus received by Qian Yan from the concealed net asset value confirmed by Baoguang Accounting Firm, the concealed net asset value of the Former Institute should be RMB 391,787.78.

After the case was discovered, the prosecutorial authority recovered all the illicit proceeds from Jiade Company and disposed of them directly.

The above facts are confirmed by the evidence adduced by the prosecutor, the evidence collected by the court from witnesses including Xu Jianyi and Qian Yan, and the project cost settlement list between the Former Institute and the Municipal Design Institute submitted by Shu Zhaolong's defense counsel. After cross-examination, all this evidence was confirmed to have probative force.

The disputed issues in this case are: (1) Whether the conduct of a state functionary in concealing state-owned assets during the restructuring of a state-owned institution can constitute the crime of embezzlement? (2) If the defendant's conduct in this case constitutes the crime of embezzlement, how should the amount of embezzlement be determined?

The Wuxi Beitang District People's Court held:

Article 382, Paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law provides: "Where a state functionary takes advantage of his office to embezzle, steal, swindle, or illegally obtain public property by other means, he commits the crime of embezzlement."

The defendant Shu Zhaolong, being a state functionary, took advantage of his position as the legal representative of a state-owned institution to conceal state-owned assets during the restructuring of the state-owned institution and transferred the state-owned assets to a company in which he held an investment stake. His conduct meets the characteristics of illegally obtaining public property by fraudulent means and constitutes the crime of embezzlement. "Illegal possession" is one of the objective elements of the crime of embezzlement. When Shu Zhaolong concealed the state-owned assets managed by the Former Institute, he knew that these assets could only be acquired by the limited liability company formed after the restructuring of the Former Institute, and he could not directly and illegally take possession of them personally. Nevertheless, Shu Zhaolong still engaged in the act of concealing state-owned assets. This is because, subjectively, Shu Zhaolong had the criminal motive of obtaining a portion of the state-owned assets through his investment share; objectively, only by doing so could Shu Zhaolong achieve the illegal possession of a portion of the state-owned assets. Therefore, calculated according to Shu Zhaolong's 25% investment ratio in Jiade Company, the amount of over RMB 97,900 out of the RMB 391,787.78 in concealed state-owned assets is the amount that Shu Zhaolong subjectively intended to obtain and objectively had already realized through his embezzlement. The 10% of the RMB 391,787.78 in state-owned assets, i.e., over RMB 39,100, remains the state-owned asset share held by the state-owned institution Municipal Design Institute in Jiade Company. The 65% of the RMB 391,787.78 in state-owned assets, i.e., over RMB 250,000, constitutes the loss caused to state-owned assets by Shu Zhaolong's criminal act, which should be considered at sentencing. To treat all the concealed state-owned assets of the Former Institute as the amount embezzled by Shu Zhaolong would be unable to explain the nature of the over RMB 39,100 in property that the Municipal Design Institute shared according to its investment stake. Such a determination would be inconsistent with the facts and with the law.

In summary, the prosecution's charge of the crime of embezzlement against the defendant Shu Zhaolong is established, but the determination of the amount of embezzlement is improper and should be corrected. Shu Zhaolong embezzled over RMB 97,900 and caused a loss of over RMB 250,000 to state-owned assets. He should be punished in accordance with Article 383, Paragraph 1, Item (2) of the Criminal Law, which provides: "Where the amount of personal embezzlement is not less than RMB 50,000 but not more than RMB 100,000, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than five years and may also be sentenced to confiscation of property." Shu Zhaolong was brought to justice upon being reported by others. Although he truthfully confessed his criminal facts after being brought to justice, he did not have the element of voluntary surrender provided for in Article 67 of the Criminal Law, and therefore does not qualify for voluntary surrender. Shu Zhaolong's defense that "the bonus received by Qian Yan should be deducted from the undeclared net assets" is accepted. The defenses raised by Shu Zhaolong and his defense counsel that "the survey fee of the East China Survey Institute should also be deducted from the undeclared net assets," "the failure to declare certain accounts receivable under contracts was to consider the interests of the restructured entity and all employees, not for personal gain, and thus the conduct does not constitute a crime," and "there is voluntary surrender" are not accepted. Considering that all the state-owned assets concealed by Shu Zhaolong were recovered after the case was discovered, the loss to the state has been remedied, and Shu Zhaolong has shown a good attitude of admitting guilt after being brought to justice, the defense of Shu Zhaolong requesting a lenient punishment is accepted. Accordingly, the Wuxi Beitang District People's Court rendered the following judgment on March 18, 2005:

The defendant Shu Zhaolong is convicted of the crime of embezzlement and sentenced to five years' fixed-term imprisonment, with an additional sentence of confiscation of property in the amount of RMB 100,000.

After the judgment of first instance was pronounced, the defendant Shu Zhaolong did not appeal within the statutory period, and the prosecutorial authority did not file a protest. The judgment of first instance became legally effective.
